document.abstract: What will media enterprise infrastructure look like in 2036? Current trends of IT/IP/cloud provide some guidance for the structure of future systems. This paper takes a deep look at the evolution of system's components and architecture and examines some possible scenarios for infrastructure choices. Considered will be; extrapolated trends for transport, networking, storage, compute and cloud futures. Discussion of exponential technology growth and its impact on media creation, production and distribution.
